publication.scope: Incremental agent/method tracing cost; existing version-contract JAR/manual probes identical in every arm.
publication.basis: Median of independent JVM runs; paired delta medians/ranges; no statistical significance or production SLO claim.

threadEvidence.scope: read-only final observations of every owned case; exact build and artifact checked

measurementDefinitions.CPU: App cgroup includes resource-sampler execs; excludes separate DB/Redis/Kafka/VM and load-client CPU.
measurementDefinitions.client: HTTP latency excludes response JSON validation and local JSONL recording; phase throughput includes client bookkeeping.
measurementDefinitions.memory: Sampled Java VmRSS peak differs from process-lifetime VmHWM and cgroup memory.current.
measurementDefinitions.completion: DB effect completion plus fixed 0.5s tail, exporter queue emptiness not proved; shutdown CPU not measured.
